analysis_rule_precision: Protocol did not fully specify normalization; both index-paired median difference and ratio of process medians are disclosed. Absolute10percent is a conservative diagnostic,not a new confirmatory success criterion.
interpretation: All comparisons use existing recorded outputs, not new WORLD/agent/replay runs.
One paired process block for P1 only;5warm calls are dependent submeasurements,not5independent replicas.
10percent flag uses absolute median of index-paired WARM wrapper differences divided by MINIMAL WARM wrapper median; ratio of separate medians also reported.
Signed differences are observed deviations,not identified causal instrumentation overhead.
Timeout censors a whole process; interrupted per-call stage not recorded and cannot be localized reliably.
Clock/empty flags certify only this detector threshold on available calls,not accuracy or GC/JIT stability.
Memory peak is sampled aggregate; per-worker CPU/RSS unavailable after killed worker has no done record.
Integrity VERIFIED does not imply complete or scientifically adequate campaign.
